description: Put named creators from a discovery search onto the campaign roster, or take them off it with delist. The first call changes nothing: it returns a proposal, a one-use confirmation_ref and the steps to apply it. On an enrollment the first call also runs the charged web safety search for creators with no fresh safety read and returns their sources for your safety read; that charge stays even if the marketer declines. An enrollment needs a request_id, and the confirming call carries safety_reads. Pass the run candidate ids, an optional note, and finalize to finish the search too. The applied reply names each enrolled creator with their contact address, none, or opted out, and whether the search was finished. Example: campaign_id spring-launch, candidate_ids from its latest creator search.

confirmation_ref.description: Absent: the call changes nothing and returns a proposal with a one-use confirmation_ref and the steps to apply it. Present: the confirmation_ref that proposal returned; Storika applies it once, and refuses it while the marketer has not pressed Approve on the Storika card shown with the proposal.

delist.description: When true, take the named creators off the campaign; one already emailed stays on.

finalize.description: When true, finish the search and approve the named creators in this call.

note.description: Optional operator note; the reply repeats it.

plan_id.description: Or the search plan id the candidate ids came from.

request_id.description: Required when enrolling. An id you choose for this enroll, up to 128 visible characters with no spaces. Re-send the same request_id with the same creators after a timeout, a dropped connection or an expired confirmation: Storika returns the web sources it already paid for and never buys them again. Use a new request_id for a new set of creators.

run_id.description: The creator search the candidate ids came from; omit both for the latest one.

safety_reads.description: Only on the confirming call. One safety read per creator the proposal asked about, from the read your subagent made. A creator with no read is not enrolled.

candidate_id.description: A candidate id this call names.

concern.description: Required with flagged; left out with clean.

links.description: The http or https pages the read relied on, the concern page first; a flagged read names at least one.

reason.description: A short reason; the reply repeats it and Storika does not store it.

verdict.description: flagged only when a page about this same creator shows a listed concern.

tiktok_handles.description: TikTok usernames to add instead of candidate_ids, e.g. Seller Center flat-fee creators; free, after one creator search.
